purpose: Alternative App Hub icon concepts for user review; not selected production assets.

variants.name: Octo Bloom
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a new alternative launcher icon for "App Hub", the app marketplace inside OctoSense.
Create one polished square 1024x1024 icon concept, presented alone, front-facing. Use an edge-to-edge rounded-square tile on genuinely transparent exterior, generous even internal margins, a bold central mark readable at 48px. Visual language: precise friendly geometry, restrained flat vector-like shapes, a very subtle two-color gradient is permitted, no bevels or photorealism. OctoSense currently uses teal, mint and blue; keep this family. The central mark occupies about 58 percent of the tile width, with balanced whitespace. No lettering, no numbers, no captions, no watermarks, no phone mockup, no contact sheet, no copies of existing app-store trademarks. This is an alternative design concept, not an edit.
Design A, Octo Bloom: a deep teal rounded-square tile. In the center, eight small rounded lozenges radiate like the eight arms of an octopus or a compact eight-petal flower, around an open square negative-space core. The rounded petals alternate off-white and very pale mint. A distinctive simple radial silhouette, calm and exceptionally legible. A warm human ecosystem of apps, not a generic gear or loading spinner. Avoid outlines or tiny dots.

Design D, App Orbit: an off-white very pale mint rounded-square tile. A bold dark teal rounded-square app in the center, embraced by one thick open circular teal arc.
